name: Tako
description: Data intelligence agent. Ask a specific data question and get a grounded, citation-backed answer (tako_answer), or pull the actual rows/charts to work with yourself (tako_search) — over a knowledge graph of 100K+ charts plus the live web. Also explores its data graph, fetches underlying source content, and runs a multi-step Answer Agent for deeper questions.

oauth2.description: Web hosts (Claude.ai, ChatGPT) authenticate via the server's OAuth flow.

apiKey.description: CLI/desktop hosts pass a Tako API token from tako.com as a Bearer credential.

skills.name: Answer a Specific Data Question
skills.description: Get THE answer to one specific, self-contained data question — a single grounded, citation-backed prose answer, already synthesized for you (relay it directly). Best for a known value, statistic, price, rate, or a direct comparison of two named entities. For broad or multi-part needs, or when you want the raw data to work with yourself, use Search instead.
examples: What was US GDP in 2024?
What was the US core CPI inflation rate in June 2026?
What was Nvidia's revenue in its most recent quarter?
What is the current US 30-year fixed mortgage rate?

skills.name: Search Charts & Pull Data
skills.description: Pull the actual data to work with — real rows/time-series and charts over Tako's curated knowledge graph of 100K+ charts (economics, finance, demographics, sports, markets, weather) and the live web, both searched by default. Reach for this when you want the underlying data to compute over, compare, or synthesize into your own thesis. Parallelize it: decompose a broad or multi-part request into several narrow single entity+metric searches run concurrently, rather than one broad query.
examples: US CPI inflation rate
US core PCE inflation rate
Nvidia quarterly revenue
Intel vs Nvidia revenue

skills.name: Explore the Data Graph
skills.description: Resolve an entity or metric name to Tako data-graph node IDs, see exactly what data Tako holds for it (available metrics, related entities, named relationships), and pin those IDs into Search or Answer for a strong retrieval boost. Use it to check whether Tako has the data before querying, and to disambiguate names. Graph calls are free.
examples: What metrics does Tako have for Tesla?
Resolve 'core CPI' to a data-graph node
What entities and metrics are related to the S&P 500?

skills.name: Fetch Source Contents
skills.description: Fetch the actual rows or data (CSV/JSON) behind a Tako card, or the extracted text behind a web result — the step after Search or Answer when you need the real underlying data to compute over, quote, or reason about. One result URL per call.
examples: Get the CSV behind this Tako chart
Pull the full rows behind this card
Extract the text from this article

skills.name: Visualize Your Data
skills.description: Create an embeddable Tako chart/card directly from your own structured data — timeseries, bar, table, financial boxes, and more. The card auto-renders as an interactive chart. Opt-in (enable with ?tools=visualize; on by default for ChatGPT).
examples: Chart this monthly revenue: Jan 50k, Feb 62k, Mar 71k
Make a bar chart of sales by region from my data
Turn this income statement into a financial card

skills.name: Answer Agent
skills.description: Run Tako's Answer Agent for questions that require figuring something out — cohort resolution, ranking or filtering a set by criteria, aggregation, and multi-hop reasoning across many entities — beyond a single lookup. Slower and more thorough than a one-shot Answer. Opt-in (enable with ?tools=agent).
examples: Compare revenue per employee across the Mag 7
Which S&P 500 companies grew revenue over 20% last year?
Analyze the correlation between rates and housing starts
